Reading

The innocent reading first. The Overview takes the name to mean Glynn's study and its findings, then lists three education products with similar names for a reader who meant one of them.

Findings
  • THE DATABASE MADE A STUDY. Academ-AI is a database of cases, with an errata page and a publishers page; the paper analyses its first 768 examples. The composition gives the paper as the entity ('a research study and framework') and the site is not among its cards; the site refused this record's summarising fetcher; its robots.txt refuses named AI agents and admits general crawlers, Googlebot among them (read by the /non row of 2026-10-29). Checked 2026-10-29 against the MMRS meta-aggregator record of 2026-10-28 and the entity's own pages, re-read the same day.
  • NO MAKER. Alex Glynn is not named.
  • THE COLLISION SET OBSERVED. AcademAI (academai.app), Academi.AI and Academiq are the name's collision neighbours as the composition layer holds them; the record had none. Added to its disambiguation.
Analysis analyst prose, not machine text

At a name whose own site refuses named AI agents, the entity is composed from the paper written about it, without its maker, and placed among three commercial homonyms. The capture supplies the record's disambiguation.
